content.short: TokenPocket is a self-custodial multichain wallet with TON support, dapp access, swaps, and wallet tools across devices.
content.description: TokenPocket is a self-custodial wallet ecosystem that spans mobile, browser extension, and hardware wallet products while supporting a large set of blockchains and dapps. Its official help center describes the wallet as a multichain product for storing assets, connecting to decentralized applications, swapping tokens, and accessing on and off ramp services from one account environment. TON support sits inside that broader offering, making TokenPocket relevant for users who want one wallet for daily multichain use rather than a TON only client.
content.meta: TokenPocket offers a self-custodial multichain wallet with TON support, dapp connectivity, swaps, and cross-device access tools.
